description: Dated events in a window, newest first: page changes, new, removed or redirected pages, noindex, canonical, index verdicts, sitemaps, speed, lost links, applied fixes, tracking changes, results-page features, Google updates. Each dated between two observations. A lead, not proof. Read-only.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

kinds.description: Comma-separated kinds to keep, e.g. page_changed,noindex_on,google_update.

page.description: One page, exactly as webops_pages returns it.

path_prefix.description: Only pages under this path, e.g. /blog.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

name: webops_timeline
title: What changed, and when
